《Reactive oxygen species: metabolism, oxidative stress, and signal transduction》：复现时可直接核对的数据、软件或实现线索。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】Whereas plants are surfeited with mechanisms to combat increased ROS levels during abiotic stress conditions, in other circumstances plants appear to purposefully generate ROS as signaling molecules to control various processes including pathogen defense, programmed cell death, and stomatal behavior.
